title: Rigidity of the dynamics of ${\rm Aut}({\mathsf{F}}_n)$ on representations into a compact group
summary: Let $G$ be a compact Lie group. Let ${\mathsf{F}}_n$ be the free group of rank $n$. We describe the orbits of ${\mathsf{Aut}}(\mathsf{F}_n)$ on ${\mathsf{Hom}}(\mathsf{F}_n;G)$ when $n$ is sufficiently large. The dynamics stabilizes: orbit closures and invariant probability measures are algebraic, as in Ratner's theorems.
